topic: The Engine of Intelligence: Cost Functions and Gradient Descent
target_audience: University students with basic knowledge of functions and derivatives.

sections.title: The Objective: What are we measuring?
lecture_lines: Neural networks begin as random guesses.
We use a cost function to measure error.
High cost means the guess is very wrong.

sections.title: Visualizing the Terrain: The Loss Landscape
lecture_lines: Visualize cost as a 3D mountain range.
Each point represents a network's performance.
We seek the lowest valley for accuracy.

sections.title: Gradient Descent: The Mathematical Navigator
lecture_lines: The gradient reveals the steepest slope.
We calculate it to find the descent path.
Moving opposite the gradient lowers the cost.

sections.title: The Learning Rate: Setting the Pace
lecture_lines: Learning rate controls our step size.
Large steps might jump over the minimum.
Small steps ensure steady, careful progress.

sections.title: The Cycle of Improvement
lecture_lines: Predict, measure cost, and calculate gradients.
Update weights to reduce error iteratively.
